S.FORM: alang Vecekadan ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Maka go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 277 buwan, 836 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 98% kyan ku 816 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 2% kyan ku 20 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 92%, Rukay 2%, Amis 1%, Puyuma 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Vecekadan hya' ga Zayazayan. tay 'zil na Vecekadan hya' ga Laulauzan. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ *e[ʦ|ʨ]eka*an ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu maka ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** rukaj * ami[s|ɕ] * pujuma * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na *e[ʦ|ʨ]eka*an ħjaʔ ɣa zajazajan taj ʔzil na *e[ʦ|ʨ]eka*an ħjaʔ ɣa laulauzan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
